summary: Thin wrapper around the imported ReleaseMutex function. Reads the mutex handle at this+0x50; if it is non-NULL, calls ReleaseMutex and propagates its BOOL result, otherwise returns FALSE.

operations.description: Guard: return FALSE early when the mutex handle at this+0x50 is NULL, so ReleaseMutex is never called with a null handle.
Read the mutex handle dword from this[0x50] (offset 0x50) into a local.
Call imported ReleaseMutex (0x0059E1A4) with the handle and propagate its return value. Sole recorded caller is sub_5837F0.
Return FALSE when the handle is NULL, otherwise return the BOOL result of ReleaseMutex.
